description: Read-only access to Ian's personal and work calendars via their ICS feed URLs. No write capability exists — the feeds themselves are view-only.

tools.name: get_calendar_events
tools.description: List events from Ian's personal and/or work calendar for a given date (or range of days starting from that date). Expands recurring events. Times are returned in America/Los_Angeles local time, which is the timezone both calendars are authored in.

date.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles local time (default: today)

days.description: Number of consecutive days to include starting from date, e.g. 7 for 'this week' (default: 1)
